title: The 4 Best Wine Coolers and Fridges Under $300
h1: The 4 Best Wine Coolers and Fridges Under $300
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for wine coolers and fridges under $300, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at wine coolers and fridges under $300 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: NewAir 24 Bottle Wine Cooler Refrigerator French Door
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-bottle dual-zone capacity, 41°F to 64°F digital range, French door, double-layer tempered glass.
strengths: French doors and tempered glass are features usually reserved for pricier units
limitations: 24 bottles is a moderate capacity if the goal is a larger collection
Compressor hum is noticeable in a quiet room

products.name: NutriChef 33 Bottle Dual Zone Wine Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 33-bottle dual-zone capacity, 41°F to 64°F range, Built-in circulation fan.
strengths: Compressor cooling and circulation fan hold temperature well for the price
Dual zones cover both red and white at correct temperatures
limitations: Fewer long-term reliability reports than the more established NewAir brand
Freestanding cabinet is bulkier than a similarly capacity built-in unit

products.name: Ivation 12-Bottle Compressor Wine Cooler with Lock
strengths: Compressor cools reliably in warm rooms

products.name: Koolatron 12-Bottle Dual Zone Wine Fridge
strengths: Dual zones for reds and whites

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
